notes.title: Smol Side Project for Yaoi Jam
notes.content:
Hiya! I know many of you are looking forward to [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i]'s final release... Unfortunately, I'm still in coding hell, and I'll need some weeks more to sort everything out. I prefer not to give a date until I've made sure that everything works as it should, the script is thoroughly edited, and the game has been beta-tested, but I can assure you everyone involved is doing their best.

In August, I took a week off (for my brain's sanity, as the hours of coding variables was driving me insane) to work on a side project: every year, I try to take part in the Yaoi Game Jam, usually making a demo for a future project. This year, since I'm knees deep in [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] and the next project is already waiting ([i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i]), I opted for transforming an old pirates AU fanfiction of mine into an original Visual Novel. Hence, I only had to translate the text into English, make a few changes, and voilá! [i][b]Jolly Roger[/b][/i] is served!

The artist for this project is Aielia Poot, who also made a bunch of cutscenes illustrations for [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] and is now eager to work on more BL games.

I'll consider bringing [i][b]Jolly Roger[/b][/i] to Steam in the future, but for the moment you can find it on itchio, for free, as all my other jam or short projects. Enjoy!

[h3][url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger]https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Our new game is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Great news! Our more recent BL Visual Novel, [i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i], was released yesterday![/h2]

[i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i] is a short thriller revolving around the Jack the Ripper crimes. It features around 35k words, two suspects, three love interests, one bad ending if you choose the wrong culprit, and one good ending plus additional conclusions with the love interest of your choice, or a solo/friendship conclusion if you prefer. The rating is 15+.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/2eaf8fc900cc69941dd478171fc65a9be9d00489.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/[/url][/h2]

Come and have a taste of the grimmest side of Victorian England!

notes.title: My Burning Heart is available in Spanish
notes.content:
[h2]The game has been updated with the [b]Spanish translation[/b] AND also the [b]voice actors' bloopers[/b]. Check the "Extras"  options![/h2]

Our voice actors had a great time recording their lines and were so kind as to share with us some of their unlucky takes... or added some spicy comments!

The French translators are still at work, but they promise MBH will have its French version very soon. So, apart from that, the only missing thing to do for [i][b]My Burning Heart[/b][/i] is the after stories, which will be worked on during the summer. I hope you're looking forward to seeing what happens to Adnan and his love interests next!

I also wanted to remind you that the digital [b]art book[/b] of [i][b]My Burning Heart[/b][/i] is available on itchio, with all the art of the game, sketches, concept art, and a short story with some past events between the Sultan Abd al-Rashid and our despicable Great Visir. 

You can find it here: [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/my-burning-heart-artbook]https://ertal-games.itch.io/my-burning-heart-artbook[/url]

notes.title: Check out our new BL project!
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] is a dating sim visual novel about art, coming of age and jazz music.[/h1]

Our protagonist, Paul, moves to Paris in 1950, pursuing his dream of becoming a great artist. He will meet an assortment of other "bohemians" trying to live out their dreams, being it becoming a painter as Paul, a writer or a jazz musician.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/e411e8ff656172237c8a0cc1d987d93e8405e0a4.png[/img]

[h2]The demo is available on [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/night-and-day]itchio[/url].[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/555b5e821a724d85efb3af3bc8a29635a3d4116d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/4f07ec2feed15611e2de2646a74ebb42aa38121b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/b0fdb9dd7a102017760ae32668d9d657263b9ca7.png[/img]

What you will find on the demo:
[list]
[*] The first two days and a half of Paul's new life in Paris! (around 10k words) We get to meet Ferdinand, Gilles and a bit of Emile.
[*] Stats system, Paris map and CG gallery implemented. 
[*] Paul and all the love interests have finished sprites.
[*] All the necessary backgrounds are in the game, although two of them lack a night version.
[*] One CG.
[/list]

There's a longer, more complete demo planned for next month, before the launch of the [b]Kickstarter[/b], that will include:
[list]
[*] The first four days: Paul gets to know Emile better and meets Bernard.
[*] Stats screen implemented (showing calendar, stats, money, and affection points with each love interest).
[*] Denis, Nathalie and Ophelia will have finished sprites.
[*] The two missing night versions of the backgrounds will be there.
[*] One additional song.
[*] Two CGs more.
[/list]

By the way, I'm taking out the flower shop scenes from the demo, except the first one, when we get some needed explanations: it would make the demo too long, and I don't know if people will be that interested about that part. Just so you know the complete game won't have just a "you go to work, you earn X points, X money": not my cup of tea. The finished game will show sprites for ALL the characters in the game, too.

Feedback is much appreciated! We need your comments in order to fix issues and improve the game!

Remember you can get frequent updates if you join our [url=https://www.patreon.com/ertal]Patreon[/url] ;)

notes.title: Full Voice Acting Update
notes.content:
Full voice acting in English added at last!

I apologize for the delay: one of the main VAs was sick for weeks and couldn't force his throat, and we had to replace the sound editor at the last moment. All in all, a bit stressful, but I think the outcome is worth it! Please download again your game and check it out for yourself!
